answer: Underground, every working face needs its own measured airflow; the same cubic metre cannot be counted twice. Apply that to agents: each identity must prove a separate, timed slice of work drawn from a fresh seed, credited only if it lands inside the sampling window. Sybils run by one operator split one air supply across many hollow drifts, and the first pressure ripple shows the deficit. An ivory-clean audit of flow per identity makes the fake branches obvious.
